Test Case 2: Boredom Activity Scoping (Multi-Tenant Isolation)

Test that boredom activities enforce org_id and project_id scoping.

Input:
- Request 1: GET /api/v1/learning-loop/boredom-activities with org1 token
- Request 2: GET /api/v1/learning-loop/boredom-activities with org2 token
- Params: threshold=0.7, limit=10

Expected Output:
- Both requests return 200 status
- Org1 candidates filtered by org_id=org_test_lifecycle_1
- Org2 candidates filtered by org_id=org_test_lifecycle_2
- No org-scoped templates leak between orgs
- Global templates may appear in both (allowed)

Validation:
- Extract template_ids from both responses
- Check for overlapping org-scoped templates
- PASS if org_scoped_leak == False
- FAIL if any org-scoped template appears in both org results

Note: Tests GAP-9 fix (multi-tenant isolation in boredom API)

metadata.expectedBehavior: No org-scoped template leakage between organizations
